title: "treponema_blast"
output: html_document
date: "2026-11-05"
---
i want to run NCBI blast on all treponema specific sequences, generating a subset of those to then get a FASTA file and put into NCBI blast
```{bash}

source /opt/anaconda/anaconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate qiime2-2026.7
cd ~/Dailey-546

qiime taxa filter-seqs \
  --i-sequences output/week3/03.2-metabarcoding-workflow/16s-rep-seqs.qza \
  --i-taxonomy output/project/16s-taxonomy.qza \
  --p-include "g__Treponema" \
  --o-filtered-sequences output/project/treponema-seqs.qza
```
exporting as FASTA 
```{bash}
source /opt/anaconda/anaconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate qiime2-2026.7
cd ~/Dailey-546

qiime tools export \
  --input-path output/project/treponema-seqs.qza \
  --output-path output/project/treponema-fasta
```
```{bash}
source /opt/anaconda/anaconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate qiime2-2026.7
cd ~/Dailey-546

qiime tools export \
  --input-path output/week3/03.2-metabarcoding-workflow/16s-table.qza \
  --output-path output/project/asv-counts

biom convert \
  -i output/project/asv-counts/feature-table.biom \
  -o output/project/asv-counts/feature-table.tsv \
  --to-tsv

awk -F '\t' -v asv="fe6872f5cf0eefa1aecce3d39b912695" '
  BEGIN { print "Sample ID\tReads" }
  $1 == "#OTU ID" { split($0, sample, "\t") }
  $1 == asv {
    found = 1
    for (i = 2; i <= NF; i++)
      if ($i + 0 > 0) print sample[i] "\t" ($i + 0)
  }
  END { if (!found) print "ASV ID absent from this feature table." }
' output/project/asv-counts/feature-table.tsv
```
